reference_costs_note: Overhead is 1.01 times M times the Cheetah horizon times the float32 policy size in KiB. Instability keeps the paper reference of 85. The reference is fixed across RTS/STR, request heterogeneity levels, and optimization steps.
implementation: Selective Pressure Allocation Section 6.3.2, Eqs. 26 and 49-52; Gaussian exploration from Yahyaa et al. (2014), Section 4.2.

bandit.initialization_note: Two full passes of 7 arms times 7 directions = 98 initialization requests, followed by 52 adaptive KG requests.
bandit.cost_reference_note: Fixed lower reference in normalized cost coordinates, strictly below nonnegative observations (Eq. 24). Distinct from the upper total-cost hypervolume reference.
bandit.observation_bounds_note: Overhead is bounded by M times the largest class payload (holistic) or target class payload (reductionist); instability is bounded by 1. Divide increments by these bounds to obtain normalized costs.
bandit.kg_index: se * (phi(q) - q * Phi(-q)); q = abs(mean - minimum_other_arm_mean) / se
bandit.exploration_note: B=(T-k)*K*D*v; K=7, D=2, T=150. k is the upcoming one-based online request; the final request has zero bonus.

evaluation.note: Approximate the sequence set over recommended arms with 16 common Sobol draws and all constant sequences; remove duplicates. Use two held-out scenario seeds, paired across algorithms, formulations, and sweep levels. Evaluation never updates the bandit.
evaluation.hypervolume_note: Empirical RTS/STR polar hypervolume of the sampled sequence set, using the same fixed total-cost reference as MORBO/qNParEGO. Plot current estimates, without a cumulative maximum.

horizon_note: Common online training budget: 150 requests. Held-out sequence horizon: 50, matching this approach in MORBO/qNParEGO. Holistic requests span all classes; reductionist requests belong to Cheetah.
comparison_note: UCB and KG share normalized cost observations, lower reference [-0.01,-0.01], directions, arm grid, online budget, evaluation horizon, and upper hypervolume reference. Their required initialization lengths differ.

original_paper.title: Knowledge Gradient for Multi-objective Multi-armed Bandit Algorithms
